title: Soft assignments are an actual randomized quantizer
statement: For probabilities r_ib, W_b=Σ_i w_i r_ib and m_b=Σ_i w_i r_ib s_i give I_soft=Σ_b m_bm_b^T/W_b, the Fisher information of the corresponding randomized categorical observation when the randomization rule is theta-independent.

proof_location.section: S1. Soft assignments are an actual randomized quantizer
